passages.heading: Gus Is For Us.
passages.text: Gus Bilirakis is delivering real results for Tampa Bay families: taking on skyrocketing property insurance, fighting for affordable housing, and working to lower the cost of living across Pasco and Hillsborough.

passages.heading: Real Results Delivered for our Community.
passages.text: Others talk — Gus works and gets results.

passages.heading: Real Results Delivered for our Community.
passages.text: When Tampa Bay families needed results, Gus delivered, from disaster recovery to lower costs. See how he is delivering for us all over Pasco and Hillsborough.

passages.heading: Deep roots. Real Results. Proven Conservative.
passages.text: Gus Bilirakis is a husband, father, attorney, and son with deep roots to this community. He grew up in the Tampa Bay area, watched his father Mike serve this same community in Congress, and has served the people of this region by quietly building one of the most effective records in the U.S. House.

passages.heading: Deep roots. Real Results. Proven Conservative.
passages.text: As a senior member of the Energy & Commerce Committee and a veteran legislator with deep relationships across the aisle, Gus has built a record measured by bills passed and dollars delivered, not cable-TV hits.

passages.heading: Planning to vote by mail?
passages.text: In Florida, Vote-by-Mail requests don't carry over from year to year, so each general election cycle you simply submit a new one. If you want to Vote By Mail for Gus Bilirakis, request your ballot today!

passages.heading: Put a Bilirakis sign in your yard!
passages.text: Show your neighbors where you stand. Yard signs are free to constituents inside the new CD 12 footprint (Pasco & Hillsborough). The campaign will confirm availability and arrange pickup or drop-off.

passages.heading: Stand with Gus.
passages.text: Our community deserves proven results. Help re-elect a congressman who delivers results and fights to lower costs for Pasco and Hillsborough.

passages.heading: Issues & Record.
passages.text: Learn how Gus is leading and delivering on the critical issues facing our community.

passages.heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
passages.text: Groceries, housing, and the everyday basics cost more every week. Families are squeezed by inflation on every necessity, workers watch tips and overtime get taxed away, and seniors stretch fixed incomes thinner every month.

passages.heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
passages.text: Gus delivered the new $6,000 senior tax exemption , championed no tax on tips and no tax on overtime , and continues to push affordability legislation that puts money back in working families' pockets, including ending taxation on Social Security, lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and his new homeowners insurance deduction.

passages.heading: Homeowners & Flood Insurance Affordability
passages.text: Floridians are losing the dream of homeownership to skyrocketing insurance premiums. Seniors on fixed incomes are being priced out of houses they've owned for decades.

passages.heading: Homeowners & Flood Insurance Affordability
passages.text: Gus filed the Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act , an above-the-line $10,000 tax deduction on homeowners insurance premiums for a primary residence, and is fighting for an Anclote River Basin study to attack the flooding driving repetitive-loss premiums in the first place.

passages.heading: One of Congress's Most Effective Members
passages.text: Talk is cheap in Washington. What matters is who actually passes legislation and delivers real results for the families and Seniors they represent.

passages.heading: One of Congress's Most Effective Members
passages.text: The nonpartisan Center for Effective Lawmaking has named Gus one of the most effective members of Congress, multiple times , a ranking measured by bills passed and results delivered, not headlines. It is independent proof of what Pasco and Hillsborough already know: Gus shows up and gets things done.

passages.heading: Hurricane Recovery in West Pasco
passages.text: Helene and Milton flattened parts of Hudson, Holiday, Port Richey, and New Port Richey. Recovery has been slow, repetitive losses are mounting, and families are tired of waiting.

passages.heading: Hurricane Recovery in West Pasco
passages.text: Gus secured $585 million in federal disaster-recovery funding for Pasco County, usable for direct hurricane relief and for the long-term infrastructure work needed to fortify the county against the next storm.

passages.heading: Mental Health & Addiction
passages.text: Every family in Pasco and Hillsborough has been touched by addiction or mental illness. The system has gaps that swallow the people who need help most.

passages.heading: Mental Health & Addiction
passages.text: Gus secured $2 million to expand mental-health services at FQHCs, brought federal funding to open Vincent House Pasco for those battling mental illness, secured funding for a one-stop behavioral-health hub in Pasco, extended telehealth for seniors through the EASE Act , and expanded the types of licensed therapists who can participate in Medicare.

passages.heading: Children's Health & Rare Disease
passages.text: Kids with rare diseases lose precious time when conditions go undiagnosed at birth, and pediatric cancer drug development still lags pediatric need.

passages.heading: Children's Health & Rare Disease
passages.text: Gus is leading the fight to expand the federal newborn-screening panel (two new conditions were added at HHS this year) and he secured the reauthorization of the Pediatric Cancer Voucher to fast-track new treatments for sick kids. He also delivered the longest reauthorization of KidCare in the program's history.

passages.heading: Public Safety, School Safety, & the Border
passages.text: Cartels are pushing fentanyl into our neighborhoods, predators are using AI to victimize children, and parents are still worried about safety in the schoolhouse.

passages.heading: Public Safety, School Safety, & the Border
passages.text: Gus secured the wall to choke off the cartels driving human and drug trafficking, passed the Take It Down Act to give law enforcement new tools against AI-generated child sexual abuse material, and brought $3 million in school-safety funding to districts in the new CD 12 footprint this year. Pasco Sheriff Chris Nocco speaks to this record.

passages.heading: Supporting the Trump Agenda
passages.text: Florida families want a Washington that secures the border, lowers costs, and puts America First. That takes a representative who will stand with President Trump and fight to get his agenda across the finish line.

passages.heading: Supporting the Trump Agenda
passages.text: Gus is a proven partner for the America First agenda, voting to secure the border, cut taxes for working families and seniors, and unleash American energy, the record that earned him President Trump's full support.

passages.heading: Supporting the Trump Agenda
passages.text: ★ ★ ★ “Gus Bilirakis has my complete and total endorsement!” — President Donald J. Trump ★ ★ ★

passages.heading: The work doesn't stop.
passages.text: Help re-elect a congressman who delivers results and fights to lower costs for Pasco and Hillsborough.

passages.heading: A Florida son with a record of service.
passages.text: As a senior member of the Energy & Commerce Committee and a veteran legislator with deep relationships across the aisle, Gus has been repeatedly named one of Florida's Most Effective Lawmakers, a ranking earned by counting bills passed and dollars delivered, not cable-TV hits.

passages.heading: Named Florida's Most Effective Law Maker.
passages.text: Gus's seat on the Energy & Commerce Committee, the oldest and most consequential committee in the House, gives him jurisdiction over health care, energy, telecommunications, consumer protection, and the Affordable Care Act. It's the engine room of the bills that touch every family in Pasco and Hillsborough.

passages.heading: Named Florida's Most Effective Law Maker.
passages.text: From there, Gus has championed seniors, kids, and rare-disease families: the longest-ever KidCare reauthorization, the EASE Act extending telehealth, Medicare reimbursement for marriage and family therapists treating seniors, the Pediatric Cancer Voucher reauthorization, and an expanded federal newborn-screening panel.

passages.text: From hurricane recovery in Pasco to lower drug costs for seniors, safer schools, stronger borders, and tax relief that puts money back in workers' pockets, Gus's record delivering for us speaks for itself!
